correctness.rationale: For arbitrary finite fields q congruent 3 modulo 4 of characteristic at least five, direct Hessian and discriminant/resultant formulae prove the full generic flex divisor. The three involutions and nonvanishing fixed-root resultants force an all-or-none Frobenius action on the quartic x-roots; resolvent square classes D1,D2 characterize full splitting. Square multipliers for g imply all four lift fibers have the same quadratic character. As fourth powers equal squares in the field, exactly 0 or 8 ordinary flexes are rational. A three-quadratic-character-sum computation gives N=(q-5-6chi(-2))/4, and the fixed-point-free (x,t)->(1-x,1-t) involution changes the sign of g and proves exact halving. Explicit examples in F7 and checks across 24 prime fields through 211 independently corroborate the identities; no reliance on extrapolation.
